neighborhoods.name: Cragmere Park & Fardale
neighborhoods.character: Custom luxury colonials, historic Victorians, and expansive 1-acre wooded lots near Ramapo College
neighborhoods.description: Scenic township bordering Rockland County NY, known as the 'Gateway to New Jersey', offering Ramapo Valley views.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Major corporate campuses (UPS, Stryker, Jaguar Land Rover HQ) provide immense ratable base keeping tax rates modest (2.126% certified).

neighborhoods.name: Ramapo River Reserve & Darlington
neighborhoods.character: Scenic estates and luxury townhomes nestled against the Ramapo Mountains and Darlington County Park
neighborhoods.description: Mountain-view residential corridor offering skiing at Campgaw Mountain and swimming at Darlington Lake.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Strong residential ratable base with robust market resale values.

equityAnalysis.summary: Mahwah Township maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Mahwah Township, homeowners pay an average of $12,170.5 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 8.29% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 82.1%, assessed values average ~82.1% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 57.6% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 31.4%, and Bergen County claims 11.0%.
